hr.title: Advent u Zmijavcima
hr.summary: Klizalište, adventske kućice i druženje za cijelu obitelj pod tisućama lampica.
hr.lead: Od 19. prosinca do 3. siječnja središte Zmijavaca pretvara se u zimsku bajku — klizalište, adventske kućice i tisuće lampica.

sections.heading: O događaju
paragraphs: Advent u Zmijavcima okuplja mještane i goste iz cijele Imotske krajine. Središte mjesta zasja pod svjetlećim zvijezdama, a oko klizališta, šatora i adventskih kućica druži se cijela obitelj.
Svjetleći natpis i okićena stabla čine kulisu za zimske večeri koje se pamte.

en.title: Advent in Zmijavci
en.summary: An ice rink, Advent stalls and time together for the whole family under thousands of lights.
en.lead: From 19 December to 3 January, the centre of Zmijavci turns into a winter fairy tale — an ice rink, Advent stalls and thousands of lights.
en.description: Advent in Zmijavci, 19 December to 3 January: an ice rink, Advent stalls and thousands of lights. Most Beautiful Advent in Croatia 2025/2026 in the municipality category.
en.imageAlt: The Advent ice rink and lights in Zmijavci from above
en.readMoreLabel: Read more about Advent in Zmijavci

sections.heading: About the event
paragraphs: Advent in Zmijavci brings together locals and visitors from across the Imotski region. The village centre glows under illuminated stars, and the whole family gathers around the ice rink, the marquee and the Advent stalls.
The illuminated sign and decorated trees set the scene for winter evenings to remember.
